# Philippa Gordon

- **Age:** Early twenties (eighteen when entering Redmond College)  <sub>[v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c19 P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged to Jonas Blake  <sub>[v3 c27 P17](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0017), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c29 P4](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)</sub>

- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa is an exceptionally beautiful girl with a vivid, rose-leaf complexion, dark-brown eyes, a rose-red, crooked mouth, and smooth brown hair with a golden gloss. She possesses a charming, crooked smile, a lithe figure, and a dimpled cheek, though she jokingly worries about her nose developing her mother's family trait. She dresses in stylish, high-quality clothes, favoring soft shades and delicate fabrics.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c4 P40](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0040), [v3 c5 P6](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0006), [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 c19 P13](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0013)_

## Personality

Giddy, sparkling, and notoriously indecisive, Philippa is an irrepressible romantic who claims to enjoy flirting and being surrounded by admirers. Beneath her frivolous, lighthearted exterior, she is a loyal, affectionate, and deeply generous friend who is entirely free from snobbery. Though she jokes about her own superficiality, she possesses a keen intellect and a warm, sincere heart, ultimately choosing love and devotion over wealth and status.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c4 P44](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0044), [v3 c4 P61](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0061), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021)_

## History

Philippa Gordon first met Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant at Redmond College in Kingsport, where she joined them in their Freshman year. Struck by their sincerity and charm, she immediately befriended them, introducing them into Redmond's social life. During their Sophomore year, Phil joined Anne, Priscilla, and Stella Maynard in renting the cozy cottage known as Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue, where they lived with Aunt Jamesina. Though pursued by many suitors, Phil struggled to choose between her two home suitors, Alec and Alonzo, until she met Jonas Blake, a poor, devout theology student. Recognizing that she loved Jonas, she refused her former suitors and accepted Jonas's proposal despite her family's initial objections to his lack of wealth. She threw herself into household duties at Patty's Place, earned High Honors in Mathematics at graduation, and subsequently married Jonas to join him in his ministry in the city slums.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P24](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0024), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c10 P49](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0049), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021), [v3 c27 P17](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0017), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c29 P4](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0004), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_
